title: Fixes landed outside quality rounds never set fixed_by, so the quality queue offered already-fixed defects
problem: Product, red-team and round PRs fixed queued quality defects in passing (PRs #18913, #18785, #17976, #18358, #18388) without recording fixed_by in the audit, so `quality_audit.py queue` kept listing them as open and fix sessions spent minutes rediscovering the fix (git log -S, PR reads, re-running cases). The earlier fixes (refresh_main, with_main_marks, the shallow-clone deepen) made 'changed since audit' answer, but a changed subject still does not say which defect closed; only the session that made the change knows.
evidence: friction_rank.py --live --ungated --days 3 on 2026-11-27: cluster 1, platform/ci/quality_audit.py, 7 sessions 2026-11-25..27, 'reported again after a 2026-11-27 verdict ... the fix may not have held'
prompts/runs/2026-11-27-session_01XpHqydQbNcsBN9xhgFUjNr.json: 'einvoice-preflight defects 2-4 open although PRs #18913 and #18785 had fixed them; those PRs never set fixed_by'
prompts/runs/2026-11-27-session_01E5sJKjKAWspJsPcGGbTzPe.json: 'defects 2 and 4 open although PR #17976 (red team) had fixed them'
change: `quality_audit.py touched [BASE]` lists the open defects (every severity) in the subjects the working-tree diff touches, with the mark-fixed command; `run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes`, the one pre-merge command most runs already make, prints the same list at the end (informational, fail-soft). portfolio/quality/README.md 'Fix forward' says so in one sentence.
metric: run-record doc_friction naming quality_audit.py queue for listing a defect another (non-quality) PR had already fixed, in the 3 days after the merge
